definitions.explanation: Great force or strength, especially the destructive or impressive power of something such as a weapon, natural phenomenon, or technique.
The power to compel or intimidate others, often through one's position, status, or implied threat.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{爆弾|ばくだん}→爆弾：10117_bakudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{威力|いりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すさまじい→すさまじい：07674_susamajii⟧。
examples.english: The power of this bomb is tremendous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{威力|いりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: Trees were knocked down by the force of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{威力|いりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: This new engine has greater power than the conventional one.

examples.japanese: {威力|いりょく}⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦{妨害|ぼうがい}→妨害：07632_bougai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested for forcible obstruction of business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{威力|いりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧。

examples.english: The crime syndicate demanded money backed by intimidation.

notes:
Combines ⟦{威|い}→威：28463_i⟧ (intimidation/authority) and {力|りょく} (power/force). The word carries a sense of overwhelming or impressive power, whether physical or social.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威力|いりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: exert power/influence
- {威力|いりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: have great power
- {威力|いりょく}⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦{妨害|ぼうがい}→妨害：07632_bougai⟧: forcible obstruction of business (legal term)
- ⟦{破壊|はかい}→破壊：13678_hakai⟧{威力|いりょく}: destructive power
- {威力|いりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: demonstrate power

LEGAL USAGE:
{威力|いりょく}⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦{妨害|ぼうがい}→妨害：07632_bougai⟧ is a specific criminal charge in Japanese law, referring to obstructing someone's work through force, threats, or intimidation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: power, strength — the most general and common word for power; lacks the connotation of impressiveness or intimidation
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧: political power, authority — specifically refers to institutional or governmental power
- ⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧: influence, power base — refers to the sphere or extent of one's influence, especially of organizations or groups
